brief:
Lebanon's Health Ministry reported 8,953 deaths and 30,643 wounded from Israeli military operations, Shehab Wire reported. The toll reflects months of cross-border strikes that intensified following the October 7 attack on Israel and subsequent operations in Gaza.

The casualty figures represent one of the highest death counts Lebanon has recorded during the conflict, with wounded far exceeding fatalities across hospitals and medical facilities nationwide.

title: Lebanon counts 8,953 dead, 30,643 wounded from Israeli assault
